mobbin:78ae405b-2c59-46f6-94bc-933c189d2.summary: From Help, the user picks a recently scanned product, chooses an issue category, and selects which fields are wrong. They write a note, attach a required photo, and get a thank-you with a 48-hour follow-up.
steps: Help with recent scans and problem list
Product context: What's the issue categories
Correct a product: pick fields, Next disabled
Detail form with empty note and Add a photo Mandatory
Choose Take a picture or Photo library
Thank you alert: reply within 48 hours
steal: Recent scans act as reporting shortcuts with a thumb and relative time (screen 1), so you jump to the item you just touched.
The scanned-item header (photo, name, status, age) stays while picking issue type (screens 2 and 8).
A required-photo label and disabled Send until evidence is attached (screens 5 to 7) force proof before submit.
A camera versus library sheet puts Take a picture first (screen 7). A closed-loop Thank you plus reply-within time closes the loop (screen 8).
avoid: A deep multi-step path (issue, field pick, note, photo) is too many screens for a gloved sim tech flagging missing or broken gear on a pre-session walk.
mobbin:78ae405b-2c59-46f6-94bc-933c189d2.fit: Mobile and iPad app: this fits equipment check as an analog. It starts from a scanned item with issue categories and a required photo. It is not a room QR checklist or tick-all walkthrough. Mobile beats the SRV because the tech is at the broken gear. Extend baseline sim-tech setup with item-level flag and evidence handoff.
